description: NaLaHfZrO₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic F̅43m space group. Na is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent HfO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.93 Å. La is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent HfO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra. All La-O bond lengths are 2.93 Å. Hf is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form HfO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Hf-O bond lengths are 2.05 Å. Zr is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form ZrO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent HfO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Zr-O bond lengths are 2.08 Å. O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent La, one Hf, and one Zr atom.
